scope: BCM6813 ARM64 kernel with ARM EABI compat syscall ABI; kernel8 baseline to candidate9

vendor_layout_assessment.crc_proof: Not available: CONFIG_MODVERSIONS=n and neither actual ELF contains __crc_* symbols; Module.symvers is not a freshly built CRC proof.

syscall_wrapper_assessment.intentionally_unavailable: 416 io_pgetevents_time64 follows existing CONFIG_AIO=n and resolves to sys_ni_syscall via its compat alias.
syscall_wrapper_assessment.calling_convention: arm64 table entries must point to pt_regs wrappers (__arm64_sys_* or __arm64_compat_sys_*), not underlying C implementations.
syscall_wrapper_assessment.pointer_and_scalar_note: ARM EABI registers supply 32-bit arguments. Native time64 handlers are reused only where argument scalars and pointed layouts match; pselect/ppoll/io_pgetevents/recvmmsg/rt_sigtimedwait need compat compound translation.
syscall_wrapper_assessment.exact_dispatch_check: Resolves R_AARCH64_RELATIVE relocations before matching every new handler; both direct and wrapper NI addresses are recognized.

identified_hazards.issue: Existing get_timespec64 nsec-high-word mask was gated by absent CONFIG_64BIT_TIME, so new ARM32 calls could reject valid ABI padding.
identified_hazards.resolution: Mask in_compat_syscall unconditionally, while retaining native64 validation.

identified_hazards.issue: Native futex copied a raw struct timespec, bypassing compat time64 upper-word handling.
identified_hazards.resolution: Use get_timespec64 and timespec64 validation; preserve old compat futex handler.

identified_hazards.issue: Changing COMPAT_USE_64BIT_TIME globally would reinterpret existing ASUS 8-byte old-timespec buffers as 16 bytes.
identified_hazards.resolution: Keep legacy helper mode and original entries unchanged.
Syntax-only AArch64 assertions prove native timex matches upstream v5.1 __kernel_timex size208 and every named field; reuse native handler.

identified_hazards.issue: Appending time64 slots alone does not translate 32-bit fdsets, sigsets, siginfo, iovec/msghdr or optional AIO masks.
identified_hazards.resolution: Separate compat handlers; behavioral QEMU tests are still needed in addition to layout/dispatch checks.

regression_requirements: Direct ARM32 old-time ABI controls plus soft-float and hard-float time64 execution, without qemu-user interception.
Past/zero timeout and future2100 timerfd/utimensat roundtrip with output canaries.
Dirty ARM32 tv_nsec upper32 accepted where ABI padding; same native64 input rejected with EINVAL.
Interrupted nanosleep/futex restart and pselect/ppoll timeout copyback preserve 16-byte time64 outputs and existing restart_block layout.
Compat pselect fdsets, masks, received siginfo and recvmmsg metadata remain 32-bit layouts.
Existing native64, PSI, container/resource, and representative vendor module regressions remain required.
limitations: ABI evidence covers surviving complete DWARF types plus exact dispatch and exports, not all undisclosed blob assumptions.
All20 slots wired does not enable CONFIG_AIO; its NI behavior is intentional and must be reported.
This audit does not claim the rest of the 32-bit socket timestamp/ioctl/filesystem time ABI is Y2038-complete.
